A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed clothoid-based path and speed profile representation is an efficient and accurate method to represent a path and to compute the optimal speed profile.
we present a method for speed profile generation and control that takes into account the semantic and geometric road information.

we present a novel method to generate optimal and smooth speed profiles in clothoid-based paths and that we show that we can generate suboptimal speed profiles by considering only the clothoid kink-points.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed speed profile generator can be used to generate smooth speed profiles that are close to the maximum speed allowed in the path.

the use of clothoid-based paths in the speed profiler formulation allows us to obtain smooth speed profiles that are feasible and safe, while being close to the maximum speed in most cases, which is the main objective of a speed profiler.
the clothoid-based representation of paths is very useful to generate speed profiles in a computationally efficient way, which is important for autonomous driving applications.
